nl: Start tools/build.py 4 in the background with its standard output written to logs/build-6.log, wait for it to finish, then write its exit code to logs/exit-6.txt.

entries.content_utf8:
import sys
import time

print("compiling", flush=True)
time.sleep(0.5)
print("linking", flush=True)
print(f"result {sys.argv[1]}", flush=True)
sys.exit(int(sys.argv[1]))

oracle_program:
run ["python3", "tools/build.py", "4"] background: true save_to: "logs/build-6.log"
jobs "j1" wait: 60s |> select exit_code |> write "logs/exit-6.txt"
reference_pwsh:
$py = if ($IsWindows) { 'python' } else { 'python3' }
$p = Start-Process $py -ArgumentList 'tools/build.py','4' -RedirectStandardOutput logs/build-6.log -PassThru -NoNewWindow
$p.WaitForExit()
Set-Content logs/exit-6.txt $p.ExitCode
